==Summary==

{{pov|[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]}}

The interrogation of [[Semirhage]] continues. Cadsuane finds a kindred spirit in [[Sorilea]], and is amazed that the [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]] manages to get a reaction from the [[Forsaken]] by noting how ordinarily human she seems. The Forsaken laughs at how these people can call themselves Aiel, having forsaken their covenant, and the [[Way of the Leaf]]. Cadsuane has only caught rumors of the Aiel past, and is curious to hear more. 

Sorilea wishes to see the male ''[[a'dam]]''. Although Cadsuane does not wish to show it, she owes Sorilea for teaching her the weave for [[traveling]]. Cadsuane has the ''a'dam'' in a box with unique inverted weaves set to capture anyone trying to open the box. Sorilea sees it as an evil object. Cadsuane would like to experiment with it but Rand prohibits any testing on the [[Asha'man]]. Cadsuane and Sorilea both agree that [[Rand al'Thor]] needs to be guided to show more emotion, or the Last Battle will be lost.
